413   always_comb begin : csr_pipeline_flushes
414     csr_pipe_flush = 1'b0;
415 
416     // A pipeline flush is needed to let the controller react after modifying certain CSRs:
417     // - When enabling interrupts, pending IRQs become visible to the controller only during
418     //   the next cycle. If during that cycle the core disables interrupts again, it does not
419     //   see any pending IRQs and consequently does not start to handle interrupts.
420     // - When modifying any PMP CSR, PMP check of the next instruction might get invalidated.
421     //   Hence, a pipeline flush is needed to instantiate another PMP check with the updated CSRs.
422     // - When modifying debug CSRs - TODO: Check if this is really needed
423     if (csr_op_en_o == 1'b1 && (csr_op_o == CSR_OP_WRITE || csr_op_o == CSR_OP_SET)) begin
424       if (csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_MSTATUS ||
425           csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_MIE     ||
426           csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_MSECCFG ||
427           // To catch all PMPCFG/PMPADDR registers, get the shared top most 7 bits.
428           instr_rdata_i[31:25] == 7'h1D) begin
429         csr_pipe_flush = 1'b1;
430       end
431     end else if (csr_op_en_o == 1'b1 && csr_op_o != CSR_OP_READ) begin
432       if (csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_DCSR      ||
433           csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_DPC       ||
434           csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_DSCRATCH0 ||
435           csr_num_e'(instr_rdata_i[31:20]) == CSR_DSCRATCH1) begin
436         csr_pipe_flush = 1'b1;
437       end
438     end
439   end
